name: Heredity
overview: Scripture reveals that heredity carries both physical and moral dimensions, as seen in Genesis 5:3 where Adam begets a son in his own likeness, highlighting the transmission of human nature. The Mosaic law emphasizes God's justice and mercy in visiting the consequences of sin upon children to the third and fourth generation of those who reject Him, while also extending mercy to thousands who love and obey Him (Exodus 20:5-6; Exodus 34:7; Numbers 14:18). This principle is further illustrated by the Israelites’ wilderness wandering, where children bear the consequences of their parents' unfaithfulness (Numbers 14:33), underscoring the serious impact of parental choices across generations.
